headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Wanbury’s Q2 FY27 (quarter ended 30 September 2026) standalone revenue stood at INR 182.91 crore, up 14.3% YoY from INR 160.06 crore and 10.5% QoQ from INR 165.58 crore.
Profitability recovered sequentially, although margins remained below the year- ago level.
Gross margin improved to 54.1% from 52.3% in Q1 FY27 but declined from 58.1% in Q2 FY26.
EBITDA, calculated as PBT before exceptional items plus finance costs and depreciation ,stood at INR 26.21 crore, up 0.9% YoY and 57.9% QoQ.
valuation: Valuation call: We maintain a Buy rating with a price target of INR 240, representing an upside of 27.7% from the current CMP of INR 188 over the next 24 months.
